sections.title: Medical wigs, *fitted with care*

image.alt: A soft blonde wig on a display stand

body: For women losing hair to chemotherapy, alopecia or other conditions, our medical wigs are silicone-lined for a secure, irritation-free fit on sensitive scalps. Choose a custom cranial prosthesis made to your measurements, or a pre-cut medical wig that we cut and style for you.

Some insurance plans cover part or all of the cost of a cranial prosthesis. We don’t file claims, but we’ll walk you through the process and give you the paperwork you need. Coverage isn’t guaranteed and is up to your insurer.

sections.title: Founded from *a personal place*

image.alt: Long, glossy auburn hair seen from behind

body: Nouveau Hair & Wigs began with a simple wish: to help women facing the emotional challenges of hair loss. Inspired by our founder’s experience with loved ones going through chemotherapy, we created a private, welcoming space where women can rediscover themselves.
Our exclusive Nouveau line of premium human hair wigs, extensions and toppers is hand-selected for texture, longevity and realism. We don’t just sell hair: we help restore confidence, beauty and joy.

items.q: What’s the difference between synthetic and human hair toppers?
items.a: Synthetic toppers are pre-styled and hold their shape after washing. Human hair toppers can be heat styled, colored and blended more seamlessly. We’ll help you choose.
